verdict.rationale: Blink's own docs show an Appearance settings section to 'style your terminal with themes and fonts' and say users can add their own themes and fonts beyond the bundled ones (including Pragmata Pro). Pinch-to-resize also adjusts terminal size. This covers the font and color parts of the story, but cursor customization is not mentioned anywhere. Missing for 10: cursor appearance customization, explicit documentation that settings persist, independent or hands-on corroboration of theming depth.
